contract.signature: from shipping import shipping_fee; shipping_fee(total_cents: int) -> int
rules: For nonnegative integer totals below 10000, return 500.
For integer totals at least 10000, return 0.
Type validation is out of scope.
contract.error_message: Unspecified; do not assert a message.

classification: test-safe requirements and public contract only
